supporting_pages.title: "Use the Feed Management UI \_|\_ Google Security Operations \_|\_ Google\
evidence_snippets: Based on the Cloud Storage configuration that you created, specify values for the following fields: Storage bucket URI Note: Use a wildcard to match an entire directory name.

Enable authentication by specifying the API key and secret key as part of the custom header in the following format: X-goog-api-key = API KEY X-Webhook-Access-Key = SECRET We recommend that you specify the API key as a header instead of specifying it in the URL.
Note: When you configure the SOURCE DELETION OPTION field, if you select an option to delete source objects, you must enable the required deletion permissions for that feed type.
